lines.line: Life doesn't wait for you to figure everything out. Sometimes you just have to make the best decision you can with the person you are today.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
lines.author: Nelson Mandela

lines.line: The older you get, the more you realize that a peaceful ordinary day is something worth being grateful for.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
lines.author: Steve Jobs

lines.line: You can spend your entire life preparing for the future and still forget to enjoy the only moment you actually have.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
lines.author: Winston Churchill

lines.line: Some of the best things in life happen when you stop trying to control every little detail.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
lines.author: Theodore Roosevelt

lines.line: You don't need to have everything figured out to be moving in the right direction.
You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
lines.author: Wayne Gretzky

lines.line: Life has a way of teaching you the value of ordinary things by showing you what it feels like to live without them.
Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
lines.author: Henry Ford

lines.line: The life you complain about today might contain things your younger self once prayed for.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
lines.author: Thomas A. Edison

lines.line: Everyone wants to be understood, but very few people are willing to listen long enough to understand someone else.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
lines.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

lines.line: The hardest person to be honest with is often yourself, because you already know which truths you've been avoiding.
We often judge others by their actions and ourselves by our intentions. That's why understanding each other is so difficult.
Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
lines.author: Sam Levenson

lines.line: Not everyone who smiles at your success is happy for you, and not everyone who questions your choices is against you.
The best way out is always through.
lines.author: Robert Frost

lines.line: Nobody can guarantee that your hard work will pay off, but giving up guarantees that you'll never find out what it could have become.
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
lines.author: Confucius

lines.line: Sometimes the biggest risk isn't failing at something new. It's spending another five years wondering what would have happened if you had tried.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
lines.author: Confucius

lines.line: Money can change your circumstances, but it cannot automatically change the way you see yourself or the world around you.
Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
lines.author: George Addair

lines.line: One day, you'll wish you had recorded more ordinary conversations with the people you thought would always be around.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
lines.author: Mark Twain

lines.line: Growing older means realizing that your parents had dreams, fears and unfinished plans long before they became the people you know today.
If you can dream it, you can do it.
lines.author: Walt Disney

lines.line: One of the loneliest feelings is realizing that the people you would show up for without hesitation might not do the same for you.
The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
lines.author: Walt Disney

lines.line: Not everyone who enjoys your company genuinely cares about your well-being. Sometimes they simply enjoy what your presence brings to their life.
It's easy to celebrate someone's success when you don't secretly compare it with your own.
All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
lines.author: Walt Disney

lines.line: There comes a point when explaining your intentions becomes more exhausting than accepting that some people will misunderstand you.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
lines.author: Theodore Roosevelt

lines.line: You shouldn't have to reach your breaking point before people realize that you've been struggling.
Keep your eyes on the stars, and your feet on the ground.
lines.author: Theodore Roosevelt

lines.line: You can be a forgiving person without giving people unlimited opportunities to hurt you in the same way.
Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
lines.author: William James

lines.line: One day, the life you're living right now will become a memory. Try not to spend all of it waiting for something better to begin.
Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
lines.author: Henry David Thoreau

lines.line: The difficult thing about time is that it keeps moving even when you're not ready to leave certain moments behind.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
lines.author: Henry David Thoreau

lines.line: You can make all the right decisions and still wonder what your life would have looked like if you'd chosen differently.
Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
lines.author: John D. Rockefeller

lines.line: Sometimes the life you wanted isn't the life that would have made you happy. It just took you a while to understand the difference.
We often remember the big moments, but it's the little moments we would give anything to experience one more time.
I find that the harder I work, the more luck I seem to have.
lines.author: Thomas Jefferson

lines.line: The saddest thing about wasted time is that you rarely notice it being wasted while it's happening.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
lines.author: Arthur Ashe

lines.line: Sometimes the people who know the most about your life are not necessarily the people who care the most about how it turns out.
The only limit to our realization of tomorrow is our doubts of today.
lines.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

lines.line: Not every person who disappears from your life is a loss. Sometimes the distance simply reveals what the connection was built on.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
lines.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

lines.line: Sometimes you discover how one-sided a friendship was when you finally stop being the person who keeps it going.
The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
lines.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

lines.line: Sometimes the biggest change in your life happens when you stop treating other people's expectations as your responsibilities.
You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
lines.author: C.S. Lewis

lines.line: There is a difference between being patient with someone and continuously putting your own happiness on hold for them.
Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny.
lines.author: C.S. Lewis

lines.line: Not every battle deserves your energy, especially when winning would mean spending more time with people who have already disturbed your peace.
Don't wait for opportunity. Create it.
lines.author: George Bernard Shaw

lines.line: Nobody tells you how strange adulthood feels when you have more freedom than ever but somehow less time to enjoy it.
You spend years trying to become independent, then realize that having someone you can depend on is still one of life's greatest comforts.
In the middle of every difficulty lies opportunity.
lines.author: Albert Einstein

lines.line: Some of the biggest decisions in your life will be made on completely ordinary days, without any indication of how much they'll change everything.
A person who never made a mistake never tried anything new.
lines.author: Albert Einstein

lines.line: Growing up means realizing that not every problem has a solution, not every question has an answer and not every ending has an explanation.
Life is 10% what happens to us and 90% how we react to it.
lines.author: Charles R. Swindoll

lines.line: You can be exactly where you once wanted to be and still feel uncertain about where you should go next.
The harder the battle, the sweeter the victory.
lines.author: Les Brown

lines.line: The strange thing about becoming an adult is that you eventually become responsible for giving yourself the reassurance you once expected from others.
Dream big and dare to fail.
lines.author: Norman Vaughan

lines.line: Life gets complicated when you realize that choosing one path also means letting go of several others.
Keep your face always toward the sunshine, and shadows will fall behind you.
lines.author: Walt Whitman

lines.line: Sometimes people don't want to know the truth about you. They want confirmation that the version of you they've created in their minds is correct.
What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
lines.author: Zig Ziglar

lines.line: People often remember the moment you stopped helping them more clearly than all the times you showed up without being asked.
You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
lines.author: Zig Ziglar

lines.line: One of the hardest things to accept is that being important to someone doesn't always mean being a priority in their life.
Not everyone who gives you a compliment wants to see you succeed, and not everyone who disagrees with you wants to see you fail.
Either you run the day, or the day runs you.
lines.author: Jim Rohn

lines.line: The way someone treats people who cannot benefit them is often a better reflection of their character than the way they treat their friends.
You must do the things you think you cannot do.
lines.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

lines.line: Sometimes the truth hurts less than the amount of time you spent convincing yourself that it wasn't true.
With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
lines.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

lines.line: People rarely change because someone gives them a perfect explanation. They change when they finally recognize something within themselves that needs to change.
Do one thing every day that scares you.
lines.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

lines.line: Maturity is realizing that you can disagree with someone without needing to make them feel foolish for seeing things differently.
If you're going through hell, keep going.
lines.author: Winston Churchill

lines.line: Never allow someone's inability to appreciate you to become the reason you stop appreciating yourself.
Do not wait to strike till the iron is hot, but make it hot by striking.
lines.author: William Butler Yeats

lines.line: You can be proud of becoming a stronger person without being grateful for everything that forced you to become one.
Fall seven times and stand up eight.
lines.author: Japanese Proverb

lines.line: Sometimes you don't miss your past as much as you miss the feeling of believing that almost anything was still possible.
The best time to plant a tree was 20 years ago. The second best time is now.
lines.author: Chinese Proverb

lines.line: Some opportunities disappear quietly, without a final warning or a dramatic goodbye. One day you simply realize that the moment has passed.
Sometimes the biggest regret isn't something you did. It's something you wanted to do but kept postponing until it was too late.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
lines.author: Confucius

lines.line: Nobody sees how many times you questioned yourself before making a decision that eventually made everyone believe you were confident all along.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
lines.author: Confucius

lines.line: You can work incredibly hard and still feel behind when you're measuring your progress against people whose circumstances you don't fully understand.
Well done is better than well said.
lines.author: Benjamin Franklin

lines.line: The most difficult part of chasing a dream is continuing to believe in it when the results haven't given you much reason to celebrate.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
lines.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

lines.line: You don't always need to prove that you can do everything alone. Knowing when to ask for help is also a sign of strength.
If you want to lift yourself up, lift up someone else.
lines.author: Booker T. Washington

lines.line: A better salary can change your lifestyle, but learning to manage your money can change the choices available to your future self.
The mind is everything. What you think you become.
lines.author: Buddha

lines.line: Don't become so focused on reaching the next milestone that you forget to recognize the person who had to grow to reach this one.
The best revenge is massive success.
lines.author: Frank Sinatra

lines.line: The life you want may require you to become comfortable with being a beginner again, even after you've spent years becoming good at something else.
Sometimes the people who know you the longest are the ones who need the most time to understand who you've become.
Change your thoughts and you change your world.
lines.author: Norman Vincent Peale

lines.line: You don't realize how much your parents have sacrificed until you start earning money and understand how difficult it is to provide for someone else.
Believe in yourself. Have faith in your abilities.
lines.author: Norman Vincent Peale

lines.line: One day, the conversations you find ordinary today may become the memories you wish you could experience just once more.
You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
lines.author: Mahatma Gandhi

lines.line: Sometimes parents don't know how to express their love in the way you need, just as sometimes children don't recognize the love already being shown.
The future depends on what you do today.
lines.author: Mahatma Gandhi

lines.line: You can move to another city, build a different life and become independent, but a small part of you will always look forward to going home.
Strength does not come from winning. Your struggles develop your strengths.
lines.author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

lines.line: Some of the most important people in your life may never fully understand the dreams you're working so hard to achieve.
Don't count the days, make the days count.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: Sometimes growing up means realizing that the people you once depended on are getting older, too.
I hated every minute of training, but I said, Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: People can spend years living in the same house and still know surprisingly little about what each other is going through.
Impossible is nothing.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: The way people behave when plans change often tells you more about them than the way they behave when everything goes their way.
We often judge people for making choices we would understand completely if we knew the circumstances behind them.
A champion is someone who gets up when they cannot.
lines.author: Jack Dempsey

lines.line: Sometimes the smallest act of consideration reveals more about someone's character than the biggest display of kindness.
It's not about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward.
lines.author: Sylvester Stallone - Rocky Balboa

lines.line: You cannot keep choosing what is comfortable today and expect your life to become different tomorrow.
When you have a dream, you've got to grab it and never let go.
lines.author: Carol Burnett

lines.line: The biggest changes in your life often begin with decisions that nobody else even notices.
Nobody can go back and start a new beginning, but anyone can start today and make a new ending.
lines.author: Maria Robinson

lines.line: You don't need to have your entire future figured out to take one step in the right direction.
Don't let yesterday take up too much of today.
lines.author: Will Rogers

lines.line: You can lose years trying to avoid disappointing people who will never have to live with the consequences of your choices.
Failure will never overtake me if my determination to succeed is strong enough.
lines.author: Og Mandino

lines.line: Life becomes lighter when you stop treating every unexpected change as proof that something has gone wrong.
If I cannot do great things, I can do small things in a great way.
lines.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

lines.line: One of the most valuable things you can learn is when to keep trying and when trying harder is only making things worse.
The time is always right to do what is right.
lines.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

lines.line: Eventually, you have to decide whether you want a life that looks impressive to other people or one that actually feels good to live.
Trust is not lost only when someone lies. Sometimes it disappears when their actions repeatedly make you question what they say.
Darkness cannot drive out darkness, only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate, only love can do that.
lines.author: Martin Luther King Jr.

lines.line: The most disappointing thing about betrayal is realizing that someone knew exactly where you were vulnerable.
I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.
lines.author: Jimmy Dean

lines.line: Some apologies are less about repairing the damage and more about making the person who caused it feel better.
Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
lines.author: Helen Keller

lines.line: The difficult part isn't always discovering that someone changed. It's accepting that you kept expecting them to become who they used to be.
What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
lines.author: Ralph Marston

lines.line: The more you understand your own worth, the less interested you become in convincing others to recognize it.
The difference between ordinary and extraordinary is that little extra.
lines.author: Jimmy Johnson

lines.line: Never make a permanent decision about your worth based on someone's temporary opinion of you.
Light tomorrow with today.
lines.author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

lines.line: You don't owe everyone an explanation for choosing a life that makes sense to you.
Perseverance is not a long race, it is many short races one after the other.
lines.author: Walter Elliot

lines.line: You can spend years waiting for an apology that someone else has already forgotten you deserve.
Our greatest weakness lies in giving up. The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
lines.author: Thomas A. Edison

lines.line: The opportunity you keep postponing may eventually become the one you explain to yourself as something that was never meant to happen.
It's possible to make the best decision you could with the information you had and still wish the outcome had been different.
A year from now you may wish you had started today.
lines.author: Karen Lamb

lines.line: Some people spend so much time preparing to become successful that they never give themselves enough time to actually build something.
Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
lines.author: Jim Ryun

lines.line: Sometimes progress looks like doing the same unglamorous things for months until the results finally become visible.
Do or do not. There is no try.
lines.author: Yoda

lines.line: A comfortable life can become an uncomfortable place to grow when you stop challenging yourself.
I never dreamed about success. I worked for it.
lines.author: Estee Lauder

lines.line: You can understand why someone behaved a certain way and still decide that you don't want to experience it again.
Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
lines.author: John Wooden

lines.line: The older you become, the more you realize that a peaceful ordinary day is not an ordinary blessing.
You just can't beat the person who never gives up.
lines.author: Babe Ruth

lines.line: You cannot control how people remember you, but you can control whether the person you are becoming is someone you respect.
Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.
lines.author: Babe Ruth

lines.line: It's strange how society teaches you to be yourself, then spends years making you feel uncomfortable whenever you actually do.
Every strike brings me closer to the next home run.
lines.author: Babe Ruth

lines.line: Some people spend their entire lives trying to meet expectations that nobody ever clearly explained to them.
The pressure to look successful can become so strong that people forget to build a life they genuinely enjoy.
Champions keep playing until they get it right.
lines.author: Billie Jean King

lines.line: Sometimes the hardest person to disappoint is the version of yourself you promised you would become.
The only impossible journey is the one you never begin.
lines.author: Tony Robbins

lines.line: You don't discover who you are by agreeing with everyone. You discover it by deciding what you believe when disagreement becomes uncomfortable.
Setting goals is the first step in turning the invisible into the visible.
lines.author: Tony Robbins

lines.line: The world has plenty of opinions about how you should live. Very few people will be there to deal with the consequences of those choices.
The path to success is to take massive, determined action.
lines.author: Tony Robbins

lines.line: As children, we thought growing up meant having all the answers. Then we grew up and realized how much of life is learning to live with questions.
Perfection is not attainable, but if we chase perfection we can catch excellence.
lines.author: Vince Lombardi

lines.line: Childhood felt long because every experience was new. Adulthood can feel short because so many days begin to look alike.
Winners never quit, and quitters never win.
lines.author: Vince Lombardi

lines.line: Some memories become precious not because anything extraordinary happened, but because everyone who was there was still together.
The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack in will.
lines.author: Vince Lombardi

lines.line: Growing up is also realizing that the people who made your childhood feel safe had worries of their own.
There was a time when a holiday meant being free from responsibilities. Now it sometimes means having enough time to catch up with them.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
lines.author: Aristotle

lines.line: We spend our younger years wishing time would move faster, then spend our older years wondering where it went.
What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.
lines.author: Jane Goodall

lines.line: Sometimes a familiar smell, an old photograph or a forgotten song can take you back to a place you haven't visited in decades.
Stay hungry, stay foolish.
lines.author: Steve Jobs

lines.line: Money cannot buy happiness in every form, but a lack of it can turn ordinary problems into constant worries.
Little by little, a little becomes a lot.
lines.author: Tanzanian Proverb

lines.line: Some people work hard to afford a better life, then become too exhausted to enjoy the life they're paying for.
If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door.
lines.author: Milton Berle

lines.line: A person's financial success tells you what they have accumulated, not necessarily what they had to sacrifice to get there.
He who is not courageous enough to take risks will accomplish nothing in life.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: It's easy to judge someone's financial decisions when you have never had to make choices with the same limitations.
You must expect great things of yourself before you can do them.
lines.author: Michael Jordan

lines.line: The difference between looking wealthy and being financially secure is often invisible to everyone watching.
Success is stumbling from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
lines.author: Winston Churchill

lines.line: You can earn more money every year and still feel poor if your idea of enough keeps moving further away.
Sometimes the biggest luxury is being able to make a decision without calculating whether you can afford the consequences.
A pessimist sees the difficulty in every opportunity, an optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
lines.author: Winston Churchill

lines.line: Success becomes less impressive when you realize how much of your life you had to give up just to maintain the appearance of having it.
Never, never, never give up.
lines.author: Winston Churchill

lines.line: A bigger house, a better car and a higher salary can improve your circumstances, but they cannot decide what makes your life meaningful.
I never lose. I either win or learn.
lines.author: Nelson Mandela

lines.line: Financial freedom isn't just about having enough money to buy what you want. It's also about having enough control to refuse what you don't want.
There is no passion to be found playing small, in settling for a life that is less than the one you are capable of living.
lines.author: Nelson Mandela

lines.line: Fear doesn't always tell you to stop. Sometimes it tells you that you're about to do something you've never allowed yourself to try.
Courage is not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it.
lines.author: Nelson Mandela

lines.line: You can be afraid of failing and still be more afraid of spending another five years wondering what might have happened.
No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
lines.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

lines.line: The first time you do something unfamiliar, you worry about looking foolish. The tenth time, you wonder why you were ever so worried.
Two roads diverged in a wood, and I took the one less traveled by, And that has made all the difference.
lines.author: Robert Frost

lines.line: Sometimes courage is simply allowing yourself to be seen trying, even when you might not succeed.
If you want to live a happy life, tie it to a goal, not to people or things.
lines.author: Albert Einstein

lines.line: A mistake made while trying something new can teach you more than years spent imagining how it might go.
The comfort of avoiding embarrassment today can become the regret of never giving yourself a chance tomorrow.
The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
lines.author: Mark Twain

lines.line: You may never know how capable you are if you keep choosing situations where you already know you can succeed.
Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
lines.author: Mark Twain

lines.line: Sometimes having more choices makes a decision harder, because every path begins to feel like a chance to lose another one.
Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.
lines.author: Zig Ziglar

lines.line: The same silence that feels peaceful when you're happy can feel unbearable when something is bothering you.
If you aim at nothing, you will hit it every time.
lines.author: Zig Ziglar

lines.line: You can miss someone and still know that bringing them back into your life would be a mistake.

I've missed more than 9000 shots in my career. I've lost almost 300 games. 26 times I've been trusted to take the game winning shot and missed. I've failed over and over and over again. And that is why I succeed.
lines.author: Michael Jordan

lines.line: Not making a decision is still a decision when the situation continues to move forward without you.
I can accept failure, everyone fails at something. But I can't accept not trying.
lines.author: Michael Jordan

lines.line: You don't always need more information. Sometimes you already know what you need to do, but you're not ready for what comes after.
If you run into a wall, don't turn around and give up. Figure out how to climb it.
lines.author: Michael Jordan

lines.line: Sometimes the future becomes clearer only after you stop trying to control every possible outcome.
Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: The longer you postpone an uncomfortable conversation, the more room you give your imagination to create problems that may not even exist.
Some chapters of life end because you made a mistake. Others end because you finally made a better choice.
Service to others is the rent you pay for your room here on earth.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: You cannot keep every door open and expect to make meaningful progress through any of them.
If my mind can conceive it, and my heart can believe it, then I can achieve it.
lines.author: Muhammad Ali

lines.line: We have more ways to communicate than ever before, yet many people still struggle to have one conversation in which they feel genuinely heard.
Genius is 1% inspiration and 99% perspiration.
lines.author: Thomas A. Edison

lines.line: The internet can show you a thousand lives before breakfast and make you feel dissatisfied with the one you actually woke up to.
Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
lines.author: Thomas A. Edison

lines.line: People often confuse having a busy life with having a meaningful one.
If we did all the things we are capable of, we would literally astound ourselves.
lines.author: Thomas A. Edison

lines.line: Some of the best moments in life happen when nobody is trying to turn them into content.
Yesterday's home runs don't win today's games.
lines.author: Babe Ruth

lines.line: The more you compare your ordinary days with someone else's best moments, the harder it becomes to appreciate your own life.
Tough times never last, but tough people do.
lines.author: Robert H. Schuller

lines.line: A life filled with notifications can still be missing the one conversation you actually need.
Perhaps the real luxury is reaching the end of a day without feeling that you spent all of it trying to keep up with someone else's life.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
lines.author: Seneca

lines.line: We spend our lives trying to make things easier, only to discover that some of our happiest memories came from times when we had very little.
It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
lines.author: Aristotle Onassis

lines.line: The things we once considered problems often become the stories we tell with a smile years later.
You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.line: You can spend years trying to build a perfect life and still miss the imperfect moments that would have made it beautiful.
Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.line: We often wish we could relive our happiest memories without realizing that the people who made them special were changing, too.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.line: Life has a strange way of making you appreciate things just after you stop having them.
Man cannot discover new oceans unless he has the courage to lose sight of the shore.
lines.author: Andre Gide

lines.line: Sometimes getting older doesn't make life simpler. It just teaches you which complications are worth accepting.
A smooth sea never made a skilled sailor.
lines.author: English Proverb

lines.line: The moment you stop expecting every good thing to last forever, you may start appreciating it more while it's still here.
Nothing is impossible, the word itself says I'm possible!
lines.author: Audrey Hepburn

lines.line: Parents often spend their best years making sure their children have opportunities they never had themselves.
Sometimes the people who gave you the most in life are the ones you forget to thank because you assumed they would always be there.
If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude.
lines.author: Maya Angelou

lines.line: You may not understand every decision your parents made, but one day you might recognize the fears and responsibilities behind them.
I am not a product of my circumstances. I am a product of my decisions.
lines.author: Stephen Covey

lines.line: A family doesn't need to be perfect to give someone a lifetime of memories worth protecting.
The best way to predict the future is to create it.
lines.author: Peter Drucker

lines.line: You can build a successful life far away from home and still find that the simplest meal with your family feels like a luxury.
Don't let the fear of losing be greater than the excitement of winning.
lines.author: Robert Kiyosaki

lines.line: The people who raised you won't always be able to help you solve your problems, but their presence can still make those problems feel smaller.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
lines.author: Aristotle

lines.line: Eventually, you realize that the people you once thought would always wait for you are also living lives that keep moving forward.
Knowing is not enough, we must apply. Willing is not enough, we must do.
lines.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

lines.line: Sometimes your biggest obstacle isn't what other people think of you, but how long you keep imagining what they might think.
Whatever you can do, or dream you can, begin it. Boldness has genius, power and magic in it.
lines.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

lines.line: Sometimes confidence begins when you stop treating every mistake as evidence that you don't belong.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
lines.author: Rumi

lines.line: Sometimes the version of yourself you're afraid people will see exists mostly in your own imagination.
The day you stop interpreting every rejection as a judgment of your entire worth is the day many doors become easier to approach.
What you seek is seeking you.
lines.author: Rumi

lines.line: There is no guarantee that the people you keep postponing time with will always be available when your schedule finally becomes free.
Don't be pushed around by the fears in your mind. Be led by the dreams in your heart.
lines.author: Roy T. Bennett

lines.author: Oscar Wilde

lines.author: Mahatma Gandhi

lines.author: Mahatma Gandhi

lines.author: Dalai Lama

lines.author: Confucius

lines.line: There is a difference between being hard on yourself because you want to grow and being hard on yourself because you never feel good enough.
Everything has beauty, but not everyone sees it.
lines.author: Confucius

lines.author: Lao Tzu

lines.author: Lao Tzu

He who knows that enough is enough will always have enough.
lines.author: Lao Tzu

lines.author: Helen Keller

lines.author: Socrates

lines.line: Some people don't listen to understand what you're saying. They listen for the moment they can start talking again.

lines.author: Socrates

lines.author: Plato

lines.author: Soren Kierkegaard

lines.line: The problem with measuring your progress against everyone else is that you'll never meet a finish line that stays still.

lines.author: Soren Kierkegaard

lines.line: Your life doesn't become smaller because someone else's became bigger.

lines.author: Henry David Thoreau

lines.author: Annie Dillard

lines.line: Sometimes the wisest financial decision is not earning more, but learning what no longer deserves your money.

lines.author: Abraham Lincoln

lines.author: Abraham Lincoln

lines.line: You can outgrow a dream without regretting the years you spent pursuing it.

lines.line: Sometimes the greatest pressure in society is not to succeed, but to succeed in a way everyone recognizes.

lines.author: J.K. Rowling

lines.line: The internet made everyone's opinion visible, not everyone's thinking valuable.

lines.line: Some truths arrive disguised as disappointment.

lines.line: A borrowed opinion is still not your own thinking.

lines.author: Seneca

lines.line: Some people miss the benefits of a relationship more than the person.

lines.line: A quiet exit can be more honest than a dramatic goodbye.

lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.line: You can outgrow a dream without making the person who once had it foolish.

lines.author: Marcus Aurelius

lines.line: Whatever our souls are made of, yours and mine are the same.
lines.author: Emily Bronte

lines.author: Emily Bronte

lines.author: Edgar Allan Poe

lines.author: Maya Angelou

lines.author: Maya Angelou

lines.line: I love you as certain dark things are to be loved, in secret, between the shadow and the soul.

lines.line: The little things matter more than people realize. Eventually, it's not the grand gestures you miss; it's the ordinary moments that never seemed important.

lines.author: Khalil Gibran

lines.line: Love possesses not nor will it be possessed, for love is sufficient unto love.
lines.author: Khalil Gibran

lines.line: Your pain is the breaking of the shell that encloses your understanding.

lines.line: Sometimes you realize that the person you were afraid of losing had already stopped being afraid of losing you.

lines.author: Rumi

lines.line: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
lines.author: Rumi

lines.line: Sometimes the relationship changes so slowly that you keep treating it like the old one, long after it has stopped feeling the same.

lines.author: Rumi
